title: Java Backend Developer
description: Sr/Lead Developer (6-8 years) Backend and architecture Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and the Spring ecosystem. Build scalable microservices and RESTful APIs following clean code, SOLID principles, and established design patterns. Design and implement authentication, authorization, and role-based access control, including SSO and external identity provider integrations. Develop and optimize schemas, indexes, queries, and transactions. Implement caching, asynchronous processing, messaging, and event-driven communication where appropriate. Diagnose and resolve performance issues, production defects, and complex technical problems. Frontend Build and maintain frontend features using Angular and TypeScript. Integrate frontend applications with backend services and ensure reliable end-to-end workflows. AI-assisted engineering Use AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate design, implementation, refactoring, testing, and documentation. Configure and use MCP servers and connectors that give agents controlled access to repositories, issue trackers, databases, documentation, and internal tools. Create and maintain reusable agent assets such as project instructions, skills, prompts, and workflows for the team. Critically review, test, and take full ownership of AI-generated code; never ship code you do not understand. Ensure AI tools are used in line with data-protection and security policies, especially around clinical and patient data. Quality and collaboration Write unit and integration tests and take part in code reviews. Contribute to application security, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Work with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and containerized or cloud deployment environments. Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, and DevOps throughout the SDLC. Mentor junior developers, including on effective and responsible use of AI coding tools, and contribute to technical documentation. Required Skills1. Java And Backend Development (Primary) Strong Core Java: collections, streams, concurrency, exception handling, and JVM fundamentals. Extensive hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and Hibernate. Proven experience designing RESTful APIs and production-grade microservices. Solid grasp of OOP, SOLID, design patterns, and clean architecture. Experience with global exception handling, validation, logging, API versioning, and standardized error responses. Strong understanding of dependency injection, transaction management, and configuration management. Experience with performance tuning, debugging, and production troubleshooting. Understanding of distributed systems, inter-service communication, resilience, and fault tolerance. Security and Architecture Hands-on experience with Spring Security, JWT, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect. Strong understanding of RBAC, authentication, authorization, and secure API design. Familiarity with API gateways, service discovery, and centralized configuration. Working knowledge of OWASP principles and common application vulnerabilities. Databases and Messaging Strong experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization. Familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. Knowledge of Redis or similar caching technologies. Experience with RabbitMQ or Apache Kafka is an advantage. Frontend Working experience with Angular and TypeScript (React experience is also considered). Good knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI development. Understanding of component-based architecture, routing, reactive forms, and state management. Ability to independently build and maintain frontend features when required. AI Coding Agents, MCP, and Connectors Practical, day-to-day experience using AI coding agents for real development work, not just autocomplete. Ability to give agents good context: clear task framing, project instructions, relevant files, and constraints. Understanding of the Model Context Protocol (MCP): what MCP servers, tools, and resources are, and how agents use them. Experience setting up and using connectors/MCP integrations (e.g., Git hosting, Jira, databases, documentation, cloud services). Exposure to building a simple MCP server or tool integration (e.g., with Spring AI or an MCP SDK) is a strong plus. Awareness of risks in agentic workflows: prompt injection, over-broad tool permissions, secrets leakage, and sending sensitive data to external services. Discipline to verify AI output through tests, reviews, and reasoning before merging. DevOps, Cloud, and Tools Git and collaborative workflows (branching, merge requests, code review). Docker and containerized applications. CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI or Jenkins. Exposure to AWS, Azure, or another cloud platform. Automated testing with JUnit, Mockito, and related frameworks. Knowledge of monitoring, centralized logging, and deployment troubleshooting. Preferred Qualifications Experience building multi-tenant SaaS or enterprise applications. Experience in healthcare, clinical research, clinical trial management (EDC, CTMS, ePRO), or life sciences. Awareness of regulated-software requirements such as audit trails, electronic signatures, 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, GDPR, or HIPAA. Familiarity with identity platforms such as WSO2 Identity Server, Keycloak, or Microsoft Entra ID. Experience with Spring Cloud, distributed caching, and event-driven architecture. Experience with Spring AI or integrating LLM capabilities into Java applications. Experience supporting production systems and resolving complex backend issues. Experience And Education 6+ years of professional software development experience. Strong hands-on Java and Spring Boot backend experience, with production microservices delivered. Practical frontend experience with Angular (or React). Demonstrated use of AI coding agents in professional development work. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Ability to own features from design through development, testing, and deployment. Excellent communication, collaboration, and technical decision-making Interested can reach us at saranyadevib@talentien.com Skills: springboot,java,microservices
